## Purpose

This tutorial converts QX200 QuantaSoft digital polymerase chain reaction
(dPCR) data to the DDES format.

Two QX200 QuantaSoft file inputs are required:

1. The head file as a csv file.
2. The amplitude data as one csv file per well.

## Load the package and example files

```{r load-files}
library(DDES)

exampleDirectory <- system.file(
  "extdata",
  "qx200_quantasoft",
  package = "DDES"
)

headFile <- file.path(
  exampleDirectory,
  "20231130_JVS230_BRIP_Duplex_Normal.csv"
)

amplitudeFiles <- list.files(
  exampleDirectory,
  pattern = "_Amplitude[.]csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
```

## Convert the files

Choose an output directory and call `convertQx200()`:

```{r convert-files}
outputDirectory <- file.path(
  tempdir(),
  "DDES-QX200-tutorial"
)

conversion <- convertQx200(
  headFile = headFile,
  amplitudeFiles = amplitudeFiles,
  outputDirectory = outputDirectory,
  experimentId = "JVS230_BRIP_Duplex_Normal",
  instrumentSoftwareVersion = "QuantaSoft",
  dateTime = "202611121300"
)
```

This writes a main file, an assay file, one intensity file per well, and a
`.ddes` archive bundling all files:

```{r inspect-files}
basename(conversion$files)
basename(conversion$archive)
```

## Inspect the converted data

The returned object contains the converted tables, and can also be inspected
directly in R:

```{r inspect-data}
head(conversion$mainData)
conversion$assayData
head(conversion$intensityData[[1]])
```

## Using your own QX200 data

You can simply replace the example head file path and amplitude file paths
above, with paths to your own files.
